subject: Fix module loading failure for redis module (#3374)
reason: The change only removes the RedisModule_OnLoad macro from src/redismodule.h, a header consumed when compiling third-party modules, and adds a test module (hellovalkey.so) plus a TCL test. No source file in src/ includes redismodule.h, so the valkey-server binary's behavior is identical on both builds; the server-side lookup of both ValkeyModule_OnLoad and RedisModule_OnLoad in module.c predates the change and is untouched.
